Container.Name: gupax
Container.Overview: Browser-based Monero mining — P2Pool + XMRig GUI with optional Tor
Container.Description:
Gupax-docker runs the Gupax GUI for P2Pool + XMRig Monero mining via a noVNC web interface.
Access the GUI at http://your-unraid-ip:6080 — just open in your browser, no X11 needed.
Set your Monero wallet address inside the Gupax GUI itself (Node tab). Mining cryptocurrency consumes significant electricity and may not be profitable.
Features: • Browser-based GUI via noVNC (port 6080) • P2Pool decentralized mining + XMRig • Optional Tor hidden service for private transaction relay • Persistent config, blockchain, and Tor keys across container restarts
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: monero xmr p2pool xmrig mining cryptocurrency noVNC

Config.Name: TOR_ENABLED
Config.Description: Enable Tor hidden service for Monero transaction broadcast (tx-only mode, P2P sync stays on clearnet)

Config.Name: VNC_AUTH_TOKEN
Config.Description: Password for VNC web interface access (leave empty for no authentication)

Config.Name: PUID
Config.Description: User ID for file permissions (Unraid default: 99)

Config.Name: PGID
Config.Description: Group ID for file permissions (Unraid default: 100)

Config.Name: SCREEN_RESOLUTION
Config.Description: Display resolution for Gupax GUI inside the container (default: 1920x1080x24)

Config.Name: MONERO_RPC_RESTRICTED
Config.Description: Restrict RPC to safe, view-only commands (default: true). Set to false only if you need full RPC access for external wallets.

Config.Name: WebUI
Config.Description: noVNC web interface - connect your browser here

Config.Name: VNC
Config.Description: VNC server — disabled by default. Only enable if VNC_AUTH_TOKEN is set (exposing unprotected VNC gives full GUI control)

Config.Name: P2Pool Stratum
Config.Description: P2Pool Stratum - Connect external miners here

Config.Name: Gupax config
Config.Description: Gupax configuration and state (wallet, settings persist here)

Config.Name: Gupax share
Config.Description: Downloaded mining binaries (P2Pool, XMRig, monerod) — persist across container updates

Config.Name: Monero blockchain
Config.Description: Monero blockchain data. In Gupax UI, go to Node tab and set database path to /home/miner/.bitmonero

Config.Name: Tor keys
Config.Description: Tor hidden service keys (keeps the same .onion address across container restarts)
